heading: Unlimited Health Insurance: What to Check Before You Buy
tldr: The term "unlimited health insurance" often refers to high sum insured plans, not truly limitless coverage.
Policy exclusions define specific conditions or treatments that the insurance will not cover.
Waiting periods dictate how long you must wait before certain claims become valid.
Deductibles, co-payments, and sub-limits can significantly impact your out-of-pocket expenses.
Always thoroughly review the policy document for terms and conditions before purchasing.
caption:
Unlimited health insurance" sounds amazing, right? But it's not always what it seems. Before you buy, it’s super important to know what the policy *doesn't* cover, how long you have to wait for some claims, and what extra costs you might pay yourself. Don't get caught by surprises later! Learn what to check to make sure your health insurance truly protects you. Read our full article to understand more.
